title: Chapter 265 Reshaping The Body
content:
Chapter 265 Reshaping The Body

Standing in the crowded crowd, Fan Chengyang felt mixed emotions.

The inconspicuous little lord at the beginning has now become a dominant overlord.

And he kept struggling, even at the cost of changing his allegiance, but in the end he still became someone else's prisoner.

He couldn't help but sigh in his heart, "bad luck, fate plays tricks on people."

Looking at his former big brother Zhuge Kewei, he was a little embarrassed at this time.

"Everyone, I will give you two choices now. One is to join Wana Town. You can join my army or choose to become a civilian. The second is to leave Wana Town. Don't worry, I will never stop you. However, the resurrection of the undead will take about ten days. You must think about where to go."

Wang Shuo believed that most people must be rational.

And those who are unwilling to join, Wang Shuo is too lazy to pay attention. He doesn't need this population at all.

Forcing people to join will reduce loyalty, which is not worth the loss.

However, if some individuals join Wana Town, it is still easy to say under Wang Shuo's nose.

If they have rebellious intentions, Wang Shuo will never be merciful.

The people below whispered to each other.

Soon, they made a choice.

Most of the gang leaders and core members chose to leave.

Wang Shuo stood on the city wall, looking at the more than 2,000 people who left, and sighed.

After a while, their figures had disappeared.

Wang Shuo walked down the city wall, and Ayub walked out of the city with the golden fire cavalry.

…

After returning to the lord's mansion, Wang Shuo called Gong Zheng, Gong Kai, and Li Jianguo to the meeting room.

Then he handed the "Intermediate General Job Transfer Certificate" to the three.

The four of them used the job transfer certificate together to upgrade to the level of intermediate generals, and there was another one, which was naturally prepared for Ayub.

At this time, Ayub was carrying out his mission.

On the plain, the setting sun was like blood, a scarlet.

Wang Shuo took out the certificate of priest job transfer again. At this time, Chang Gui immediately said: "Lord, give me this!"

Wang Shuo was slightly startled and joked: "You don't even have a body, how can you change your job?"

"Lord, I know a secret method that can cast a body that can accommodate the soul."

"Huh?"

After Chang Gui told Wang Shuo the secret method.

Wang Shuo frowned. This casting method is similar to the manufacturing method of the golden armor warrior, but it requires a large amount of dark wood.

At present, dark wood is extremely precious to Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo immediately summoned Hadro.

When they left last time, the two agreed that Hadro would help collect dark wood.

After Hadro came, he brought 10,000 units of dark wood.

Wang Shuo traded it for 200,000 energy crystals.

One unit of dark wood can make thousands of dead spirit beads.

With so many dark woods, Wang Shuo directly asked the woodworking workshop to use 500 units of dark woods, plus some precious woods collected from the Nanshanji warehouse, to cast a body for Chang Gui.

Just then, Da Huang ran out from the backyard.

What made Wang Shuo's eyes light up was that there was also a black native dog and a white pug following behind it.

Wow!

He also found two little friends!

Wang Shuo squatted down, stroked Da Huang, and then stroked the black dog and the pug.

The two dogs did not dodge, and seeing Da Huang's intimate look, they seemed to let down their guard.

"Woof, woof"

Wang Shuo understood that this was what Da Huang wanted to eat.

So he took out a handful of energy crystals from his backpack and put them in front of them.

This is equivalent to his own child, bringing a few friends, and wanting to treat the friends to food.

Wang Shuo still has to give this face.
